datasource_item.source_question_text:
A Chinook salmon can jump out of water with a speed v0 and an angle 𝜃 above the horizontal. What is the speed of the fish when it is at the maximum height?
A. 𝑣0. [incorrect]
B. 𝑣0 cos𝜃. [correct]
C. 𝑣0 sin𝜃. [incorrect]
D. 0. [incorrect]
datasource_item.generated_question_text:
A basketball is launched with speed v0 at an angle θ above the horizontal.
What is the ball’s speed at its maximum height (neglect air resistance)?
A. v0. This ignores that the vertical component of velocity decreases to zero at the top. [incorrect]
B. v0 cos θ. At maximum height the vertical velocity is zero, so the speed equals the unchanged horizontal component v0 cos θ. [correct]
C. v0 sin θ. This mistakenly takes the initial vertical component as the speed at the top, even though it becomes zero there. [incorrect]
D. 0. Only the vertical component becomes zero at the top; the horizontal component generally remains nonzero. [incorrect]
